prompt: A request for an AI use case reached me, and I take it in as a subject: Complaint triage assistant, asked by the head of customer care of Harbour Bank. The problem: complaints wait three days before anyone reads them. The data needed: two years of complaint mails, with their category. The expected gain: every complaint routed to the right team within one hour. The work changes: the care agents stop sorting complaints by hand. Propose its scores. I accept the subject as I described it, in advance: record it at once. Your scores I want to see before anything of them is recorded.
